accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT a stated purpose of the Polavaram Project?
accepted.x: Polavaram is a multipurpose project intended for irrigation, drinking water, hydropower and flood control; salt production is not listed as its purpose.
accepted.tq: Find the option that does not belong to the stated multipurpose functions.
accepted.sec: Irrigation projects of AP → river, district, purpose  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Pattiseema Lift Project:
1. It transfers water from the Godavari to the Krishna.
2. It operates through the Polavaram right canal.
3. It is associated with West Godavari district.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Pattiseema lift links the Godavari and Krishna through the Polavaram right canal and is associated with West Godavari district.
accepted.tq: Check each project feature separately before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Irrigation projects of AP → river, district, purpose  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Vamsadhara Project is popularly known as the ‘Lifeline of North Coastal Andhra Pradesh’. It is associated with which district?
accepted.x: The Vamsadhara Project is associated with Srikakulam district and is described as the Lifeline of North Coastal Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Use the title–location association to distinguish nearby irrigation projects.
accepted.sec: Irrigation projects of AP → river, district, purpose  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Veligonda Project receives water from the Srisailam reservoir through tunnels and serves which combination of districts?
accepted.x: The Veligonda Project draws from the Srisailam reservoir through tunnels and serves Prakasam, Nellore and YSR Kadapa districts.
accepted.tq: Match the source and served districts rather than relying on the project name alone.
accepted.sec: Irrigation projects of AP → river, district, purpose  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Handri-Neeva Sujala Sravanthi is primarily associated with which of the following?
o: Lift irrigation from the Krishna for drought-prone Rayalaseema
Irrigation from the Pennar in Nellore district
Diversion of the Godavari to the Krishna through a right canal
accepted.x: Handri-Neeva is a Krishna-based lift irrigation project intended for drought-prone Rayalaseema.
accepted.tq: Identify the project by combining its source, irrigation method and beneficiary region.
accepted.sec: Irrigation projects of AP → river, district, purpose  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Galeru-Nagari — Krishna flood water and Gandikota reservoir
accepted.x: Galeru-Nagari uses Krishna flood water and is associated with the Gandikota reservoir in Kadapa. Gandipalem is on the Pillaperu in SPSR Nellore, while Somasila and Kandaleru are associated with the Pennar/Telugu Ganga system in Nellore.
accepted.tq: Use the source–location pair to reject swapped project details.
accepted.sec: Irrigation projects of AP → river, district, purpose  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Gandipalem Project is a medium irrigation project on which river and in which district?
accepted.x: Gandipalem is a medium project on the Pillaperu River in SPSR Nellore district.
accepted.tq: Directly test the river–district association of a less familiar project.
accepted.sec: Irrigation projects of AP → river, district, purpose  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Somasila and Kandaleru Projects are associated with which combination?
accepted.x: Somasila and Kandaleru are associated with the Pennar/Telugu Ganga system and are located in Nellore district.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure river-system pair to identify the correct combination.
accepted.sec: Irrigation projects of AP → river, district, purpose  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: As reported in May 2026, which combination correctly represents the status of the Polavaram Project?

45% civil works, 88% land acquisition and 93% rehabilitation and resettlement completed
93% civil works, 88% land acquisition and 45% rehabilitation and resettlement completed

accepted.s: The left-canal water of the Polavaram Project was reported to be supplied through which lift from July 2026?

accepted.s: The Gandikota reservoir drinking-water scheme additionally serves which districts?
accepted.x: The Gandikota reservoir now also feeds a multi-village drinking-water scheme for Chittoor, Annamayya and Tirupati.

accepted.s: How many agro-climatic zones are recognised in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh has six agro-climatic zones.
accepted.tq: Directly test the number of recognised zones.
accepted.sec: Agro-climatic zones of AP - number, names, headquarters  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following is the correct pairing of an agro-climatic zone and its headquarters?
accepted.x: The headquarters of the North Coastal agro-climatic zone is Anakapalle. The Godavari, Krishna and Southern zones have their headquarters at Maruteru, Lam and Tirupati respectively.
accepted.tq: Match each zone with its RARS headquarters and reject shifted locations.
accepted.sec: Agro-climatic zones of AP - number, names, headquarters  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Agro-climatic zone)
 a. Godavari
 b. Krishna
 c. Scarce Rainfall
 d. High Altitude and Tribal

List-II (Headquarters)
 i. Chintapalle
 ii. Lam, Guntur
 iii. Maruteru
 iv. Nandyal

Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
accepted.x: Godavari is headquartered at Maruteru, Krishna at Lam, Scarce Rainfall at Nandyal and High Altitude and Tribal at Chintapalle.
accepted.tq: Start with the distinctive headquarters and complete the code by elimination.
accepted.sec: Agro-climatic zones of AP - number, names, headquarters  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding Andhra Pradesh’s agro-climatic zones is correct?
1. The Southern Zone includes Chittoor, YSR Kadapa and SPS Nellore.
2. The Scarce Rainfall Zone includes Kurnool and Anantapur.
3. Agency areas are included in the High Altitude and Tribal Zone.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: the Southern Zone includes Chittoor, YSR Kadapa and SPS Nellore; the Scarce Rainfall Zone includes Kurnool and Anantapur; and Agency areas form the High Altitude and Tribal Zone.
accepted.tq: Verify district groupings one statement at a time before choosing the coded answer.
accepted.sec: Agro-climatic zones of AP - number, names, headquarters  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: What proportion of Andhra Pradesh’s soil categories is stated to cover over 88% of the state?
accepted.x: Ten of the 22 soil categories cover over 88% of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Link the category count with the stated geographical coverage.
accepted.sec: Agro-climatic zones of AP - number, names, headquarters  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the PM-MKSSY sub-scheme?
o: It operates from 2019–20 to 2024–25 with an allocation of ₹20,000 crore and provides fishing-ban relief.
It operates from 2024–25 to 2026–27 with an allocation of ₹863.86 crore and provides electricity subsidy.
It operates from 2023–24 to 2026–27 with an allocation of ₹6,000 crore and promotes aquaculture insurance and credit.
It operates from 2025–26 to 2028–29 with an allocation of ₹35 crore and provides diesel subsidy.
accepted.x: PM-MKSSY runs from 2023–24 to 2026–27, has an allocation of ₹6,000 crore and promotes aquaculture insurance and credit.
accepted.tq: Separate the scheme’s period, financial size and purpose from other fisheries measures.
